definitions.full: H8518. talah תָּלָה verb hang (Late Hebrew id. ; Assyrian Pi`el tullû , hang up ; Arabic let down, dangle (a rope, etc.); Aramaic תְּלָא , hang ; perhaps Old Aramaic תלה id. , Lzb 386 ; Ethiopic in derived sense, be devoted, addicted, to ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ת Gen 40:22 +; 2 masculine singular וְתָלִ֫יתָ Deut 21:22 consecutive; 3 plural תָּלוּ Est 8:7 ; 9:14 suffix תלום 2Sam 21:12 Kt (Qr see תלא ), etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix וַיִּתְלֵם Josh 10:26 , etc.; Imperative masculine plural suffix תְּלֻהוּ Est 7:9 ; Infinitive construct לִתְלוֺת Ezek 15:3 ; Est 6:4 ; Participle active תֹּלֶה Job 26:7 ; passive תָּלוּי Deut 31:23 2 t., plural תְּלוּיִם Josh 10:26 ; — hang: 1 hang up any object: accusative of hands and feet of slain, + עַלהַֿבְּרֵכָה 2Sam 4:12 ; תָּלוּי of Absalom בָּאֵלָה in the terebinth 18:10 ; ׳ת with accusative of thing, + עַל Isa 22:24 ; Ezek 15:3 ; Song 4:4 ; Psa 137:2 ; subject ׳ת עַלבְּֿלִימָה אֶרֶץ ׳י, Job 26:7 . 2 specifically put to death by hanging , with accusative of person Gen 40:22 ; 41:13 (both E), 2Sam 21:12 (compare תלא ), Est 9:14 ; absolute תָּלוּי Deut 21:23 one hanged ; accusative of person + עַלעֵֿץ Gen 40:19 (E), Deut 21:22 ; Josh 8:29 ; 10:26 (twice in verse) (all J E), Est 5:14 ; 6:4 ; 7:9-10 , 8:7 ; 9:13 , 25 . Niph`al Perfect 3plural נִתְלוּ בְּיָדָם שָׂרִים Lam 5:12 princes have been hung up by their hands; Imperfect 3masculine plural עַלעֵֿץ וַיִּתָּלוּ Est 2:23 they were hanged on a tree ; + 3 masculine singular with apocope וַיִּתָּל 2Sam 18:9 (for וַיּתַֻּן see נתן Hoph`al ).
